interpretation: Fossil compression does not preserve exact living depth. Shell thickness, body padding, color, joint angles and pose are interpretations. Head homologies and phylogenetic placement remain researched questions; follow the cited museum interpretation without claiming certainty. Reduced or absent eyes are unresolved: omit prominent eyes, not claim proven blindness. Exact dimensions and limb counts below are modeling conventions, not specimen measurements.
counting_note: 50 trunk station pairs, excluding antennules, mouthparts, grasping pair and tail. Eight modeled robust anterior pairs, posterior outer flap enlargement beginning at pair nine; simplified approximation, not a measured count.
